How the Liberal University Hurts the Liberal Student

As a liberal student I generally agree with the theory in this video, however there are two points I have against it. Firstly we do get to experience opposing views if we want to both through the internet and our own peers. Secondly, this video falsely equates liberal with democrat and conservative with republican. While there are more liberal than conservative university professors in my experience, it's no where near as extreme as you'd think, at least at my university. Many "liberal" professors are more moderate or just progressive, and some are even on the right of the spectrum in the context of the world. The definitions of political stances are skewed very far left of what they actually are in the U.S. Germany's parliament for example currently has a CDU majority, which over there is considered a center-right party but based on their policies is probably more left leaning than the fringe of the democrats here in the U.S.
